common.shareErrorMessage: Please try again in a moment.

onboarding.title: Welcome to Kindwords
onboarding.subtitle: Which of these feel like you right now? Pick as many as you like — this just helps us choose kinder words for you.

home.heading: A kind word for you
home.notForMeThanks: Got it. We'll show fewer like that one.

checkIn.question: How are you today?
checkIn.privacy: Only used to pick a fitting kind word. Stays on this phone.

settings.title: Settings
settings.circumstancesSubtitle: This changes which kind words show up around the app.
settings.appearanceSubtitle: Pick whichever feels most like home.
settings.uiLanguageSubtitle: What the app itself is written in.
settings.quoteLanguageSubtitle: What language the quotes themselves are chosen in — can be different from the app language.
settings.checkInSubtitle: A one-tap "How are you today?" on Home, only used to pick a fitting kind word. Your answer stays on this phone and is forgotten the next day.
settings.forgetNotForMeConfirmMessage: Quotes you marked "not for me" can show up again, and we'll stop leaning away from ones like them.
settings.forgetNotForMeDone: Done — every kind word is back in the mix.
settings.quietHoursSubtitle: We won't schedule reminders inside this window.
settings.gentlePacingSubtitle: If Kindwords goes unopened for a few days, kind words come a little less often (never less than about once a week), and go back to normal as soon as you open the app.
settings.summaryDaily: Saved. A kind word every day at {{time}}.
settings.summaryThreePerWeek: Saved. A kind word every Monday, Wednesday and Friday at {{time}}.
settings.summaryCustom: Saved. Kind words every day at {{times}}.
settings.summaryNoTimes: Saved. All your times are inside quiet hours, so there are no regular kind words for now.
settings.futureNotesOne: Plus {{count}} note waiting for future you.
settings.futureNotesOther: Plus {{count}} notes waiting for future you.
settings.forSomeoneOne: Plus {{count}} reminder to send a note to someone else.
settings.forSomeoneOther: Plus {{count}} reminders to send notes to others.
settings.permissionDenied: Notifications are turned off for Kindwords in your phone's settings. Please allow them there, then try saving again.

events.title: Calendar
events.subtitle: Add a date that matters, and we'll send a kind word the day before and the day after.
events.remindersOffHint: Kind word reminders are turned off in Settings, so these won't send anything for now.
events.quietHoursHint: Your quiet hours include {{time}}, when event kind words are sent, so they're skipped for now.
events.noRemindersLeft: No kind words left to send for this one.

notes.title: Notes
notes.subtitle: Write a note to yourself or to future you, keep a message from someone you love, or write one for someone else's important day. Notes for you are slipped in among your kind words now and then.
notes.remindersOffHint: Kind word reminders are turned off in Settings, so notes won't be sent for now.

placeholders.self: e.g. You've made it through hard days before.
placeholders.future: e.g. I hope you're being gentle with yourself.
placeholders.for_someone: e.g. Thinking of you today. I'm here if you need anything.

notes.forSomeoneHelp: We'll remind you at {{time}} that day, so you can send it to them.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.subtitle: Kind words you've saved to come back to.
favorites.emptyText: No favorites yet. Tap the heart under a quote on Home to save it here.

kindWord.missingText: This kind word isn't available anymore.
kindWord.notForMeMessage: We won't send that one again, and we'll send fewer like it.

send.title: Send a kind word
send.subtitle: Pick one or write your own, then choose who it's for.
send.writePlaceholder: e.g. Just wanted you to know I'm thinking of you.
send.emptyPreview: Write something above to see how it will look.
send.includeLinkSubtitle: So they can get kind words now and then too, if they'd like.
send.linkLine: Sent with Kindwords. If you'd like kind words now and then too: {{url}}

quoteActions.sendAccessibility: Send this kind word to someone
quoteActions.shareAccessibility: Share this quote as an image
quoteActions.notForMeAccessibility: Not for me: hide this quote and show fewer like it
quoteActions.snoozeAccessibility: Pause kind words for a while

notifications.forSomeoneTitle: Your note for {{name}} is ready to send
